What Simply Nootropics Needed From Their New Shopify Setup

Simply Nootropics operates in a competitive nootropics ecommerce space where trust, education, and purchase confidence matter just as much as product quality. Their store needed to communicate the value of the brand more clearly while also making it easier for customers to explore products, understand benefits, and purchase with confidence.

We approached the store as a full Shopify CRO for supplement brand project — not just a redesign, but a growth-focused rebuild.

Shopify Redesign and Custom Development

We redesigned the storefront to create a cleaner, more premium, and more conversion-oriented experience aligned with the expectations of a modern brain supplement ecommerce brand. The new design focused on stronger hierarchy, improved navigation, better mobile usability, and a clearer path from product discovery to checkout.

From a development perspective, we implemented a more flexible and scalable storefront structure with a focus on:

clearer product presentation;

stronger collection and product pages;

improved mobile shopping flow;

better merchandising blocks;

smoother conversion paths.

The result was a more polished Shopify redesign for wellness ecommerce that better reflected the quality of the brand and supported future optimization.

Personalized Shopping With a Shopify Product Quiz

One of the most valuable additions to the store was a Shopify product quiz designed to help customers choose the right supplements based on their goals and needs.

For a cognitive health supplement store, this is especially important. Many customers are interested in benefits like focus, memory, sleep, stress support, or longevity, but they are not always sure which product is right for them. The quiz created a more guided Shopify personalized shopping experience, reduced decision fatigue, and improved product discovery.

This feature also supported a stronger Shopify quiz funnel and more relevant product recommendations across the store.

Okendo, Recharge, Rebuy, and Klaviyo Integrations

A major part of the project involved implementing the right Shopify app ecosystem to support trust, retention, and average order value growth.

We integrated Okendo to improve social proof and customer confidence through a stronger Shopify reviews setup. For a health and wellness Shopify brand, visible customer validation plays a major role in conversion.

We also implemented Recharge Shopify integration to support subscriptions and recurring orders — a key part of subscription ecommerce on Shopify for supplement brands. This made it easier for customers to subscribe, save, and reorder naturally.

To improve basket value, we implemented Rebuy Shopify integration for smarter upsells and product recommendations. This supported a more effective Shopify upsell and cross-sell strategy across the shopping journey.

On the retention side, we helped establish the foundation for Klaviyo Shopify integration and email marketing automation, supporting stronger post-purchase communication, customer retention, and repeat order potential.

Shopify Localization and Multi-Store Expansion

One of the most strategically important parts of this project was the launch of four localized Shopify stores for different markets: Australia, New Zealand, Europe, and Global.

This was not just a design or content exercise. It required a scalable Shopify multi-store setup and a more structured Shopify international store architecture that could support regional growth more effectively.

For a supplement brand selling across multiple markets, localization matters far beyond language or currency. It affects customer trust, shopping clarity, and the overall buying experience. By creating localized Shopify stores, we helped Simply Nootropics build a stronger foundation for Shopify international expansion and multi-market ecommerce.

A More Scalable Shopify Ecosystem for Growth

The final result was a more complete and conversion-ready Shopify ecosystem built around how supplement customers actually shop.

Instead of relying on a basic storefront, Simply Nootropics now has a stronger ecommerce foundation that combines:

Shopify redesign

custom development

product quiz implementation

Okendo reviews integration

Recharge subscription setup

Rebuy upsell implementation

Klaviyo email automation

Shopify localization

This project is a strong example of Shopify development for a supplement brand done with long-term growth in mind — combining brand presentation, conversion optimization, retention strategy, and international scalability into one cohesive system.

Brand Requirements and Scale

International Commerce Architecture

Selling across borders introduces complexity at every step. We implemented a market-aware system that adapts the entire experience based on visitor location. Currency displays correctly. Shipping options match available carriers. Payment methods include local preferences.

Tax compliance automation handles VAT calculations accurately. Different rates apply based on product category and destination. The system generates proper documentation for customs. International orders no longer require manual intervention — they just work.

translated content management across all market languages;

localized payment options including regional favorites;

Dynamic element isolation. Interactive components load separately from page foundations.

Database query optimization. Read-heavy traffic patterns receive specific tuning.

Load balancing. Traffic distributes across multiple server instances automatically.

Failover protocols. Backup systems activate before primary systems degrade.

SpokeX sells high-end bicycle components and accessories. Their previous website? It failed to showcase product details properly. Customers struggled to find compatible parts for specific bike models. Too many abandoned carts at checkout. Mobile users had it even worse.

The SpokeX team came to us with clear objectives. Faster page loads. Better product filtering. A checkout that actually converts. We listened, asked a lot of questions, and proposed a ground-up Shopify build tailored to their catalog structure.

Technical Solutions We Implemented

Building an effective cycling store requires understanding how enthusiasts shop. They search by bike type, component category, brand, and compatibility — often all at once. We created a multi-layered filtering system that handles these parameters simultaneously. Results update instantly. No full page reloads.

Product pages received special attention during development. Each item displays technical specifications in an organized format. High-resolution zoom lets customers examine thread patterns and finishes closely. And here's something cyclists really appreciate: a compatibility checker that cross-references parts with popular bike models.

Our development approach included several key technical improvements:

Lazy loading for images. Product galleries load progressively as users scroll. This cut initial page load time by 40 percent.

Dynamic inventory display. Stock levels update in real time across all product variants. Customers see exactly what remains available.

Smart search with autocomplete. The search bar suggests products, categories, and brands as shoppers type. Results appear within 200 milliseconds.

Structured data markup. Google now displays rich snippets for SpokeX products. Click-through rates from search improved significantly.

These technical choices work together to create a fast, reliable shopping experience. Visitors find products quickly and complete purchases without the usual friction points.

Design Choices That Drive Sales

The visual language of the SpokeX store reflects cycling culture. Clean lines. Generous white space. Photography that highlights product craftsmanship rather than lifestyle fluff. Color palette? Carbon fiber and anodized aluminum tones — what you'd expect from premium bike parts.

Navigation follows how cyclists actually think about purchases. Main menu organizes products by bike type first, then component category. A secondary navigation bar gives quick access to popular brands and current promotions.

We paid close attention to typography and readability throughout. Body text uses a sans-serif font at comfortable sizes. Headlines create visual hierarchy without overwhelming anything. Technical specifications appear in monospace — easier to scan that way.

The mobile experience got equal consideration from day one. Here's what we focused on:

touch targets that meet accessibility standards without feeling cramped;

swipe gestures that work naturally on product galleries;

cart drawer that slides from the right without disrupting browsing;

sticky add-to-cart buttons on longer product pages;

simplified filtering that doesn't require precise tapping.

The result feels native to mobile rather than a squeezed desktop layout. Users actually complete purchases on their phones now.

Results After Launch

SpokeX saw measurable improvements within the first month. Average session duration increased by 65 percent. Bounce rate dropped from 58 to 34 percent. Most importantly, conversion rates nearly doubled compared to the old platform.

Mobile sales grew even faster than desktop. The responsive design and optimized checkout removed barriers that previously cost sales. Customer service inquiries about orders decreased as the tracking system became more transparent.

We continue supporting SpokeX with ongoing optimization. Monthly performance reviews identify new opportunities. Recent updates include a loyalty program integration and expanded payment options for international customers.

Wellness Brand Positioning

The previous website created the opposite of relaxation. Cluttered layouts and aggressive pop-ups contradicted the brand promise. Loading delays frustrated visitors. The disconnect between brand values and digital experience cost sales.

Designing for Calm

We approached the Relaxe redesign as an exercise in digital tranquility. Color palettes draw from natural spa environments. Animation stays subtle and purposeful. Transitions feel smooth rather than jarring.

The homepage welcomes without demanding. Featured products appear gently. Navigation options present clearly without overwhelming. The overall sensation mirrors walking into a well-designed wellness space.

Visual choices throughout support the calming intention:

muted photography tones reduce visual stimulation;

generous padding creates breathing room between elements;

font selections favor readability over trendy styling;

imagery shows products in peaceful contexts;

motion appears sparingly and smoothly.

Every design decision asks whether it contributes to or detracts from relaxation.

Bundle builders encourage complete wellness routines. Customers combine complementary products at slight discounts. These bundles increase average order values while genuinely serving customer needs.

Gift subscriptions serve an important market segment. Self-care subscriptions make thoughtful presents. The gifting flow separates payment from recipient experience appropriately.

Sample programs let customers try before committing to full sizes. Scent profile descriptions use consistent vocabulary customers learn to interpret. Customer reviews specifically address fragrance characteristics.

The scent finder tool matches preferences to products:

Preference questions. Customers indicate favorite scents from everyday life.

Mood selection. Desired emotional outcomes guide recommendations.

Experience level. Beginners receive accessible suggestions. Enthusiasts see nuanced options.

Sensitivity considerations. Customers with fragrance sensitivity see appropriate products.

This guidance reduces the risk that stops fragrance purchases online.

Business Outcomes

Relaxe conversion rates improved 78 percent after launch. Customer feedback specifically mentions the pleasant shopping experience. Return rates dropped as product selection matched expectations better.

Subscription enrollment exceeded projections. The non-pushy approach actually converts better than aggressive tactics. Recurring revenue now provides stable business foundation.

We continue developing the Relaxe platform. Recent additions include a guided meditation content library and a wellness coaching appointment system. The store grows as the brand expands their offerings.

projects.solution:
Project Background and Requirements

VitaChipus produces vitamin complexes, minerals, and specialty supplements. Their target customers research thoroughly before purchasing. They read ingredient lists. They check dosages against studies. The previous website lacked the educational depth these customers expected.

The brand also faced challenges with subscription management. Many supplement users prefer automatic reorders — it's just easier. But the old system handled recurring orders poorly. Billing errors. Customer frustration. This directly impacted retention rates and lifetime customer value.

Compliance-First Development Approach

Supplement retail involves strict regulations about health claims. You can't just say whatever sounds good. We built content management systems that help VitaChipus maintain compliance naturally. Product descriptions separate factual information from general wellness statements clearly.

The development process addressed regulatory requirements systematically:

Disclaimer placement. Required legal notices appear consistently across all product pages. Staff cannot accidentally remove them when editing content.

Ingredient transparency. Each product displays complete supplement facts panels. Customers see exactly what they purchase.

Source documentation. Links to third-party testing results build credibility. Certificates of analysis load in modal windows without leaving product pages.

Age verification. Certain products require confirmation before adding to cart. The system handles restricted items appropriately.

This compliance framework protects VitaChipus legally while building consumer trust. Customers appreciate knowing exactly what they put in their bodies.

Subscription Commerce Implementation

Recurring revenue stabilizes supplement businesses. Makes forecasting easier. Reduces customer acquisition pressure. We implemented a robust subscription system that handles the complexity of health products. Customers choose delivery frequency based on their actual usage patterns.

The subscription dashboard gives buyers complete control. Pause deliveries during travel. Swap products between shipments. Adjust quantities as needs change. This flexibility reduces cancellations dramatically — people stay subscribed when they don't feel trapped.

We integrated the subscription engine with inventory forecasting. VitaChipus now predicts demand more accurately. Stock-outs decreased by 73 percent after implementation. Customers receive supplements reliably every cycle.

Educational Content Integration

Supplement shoppers want information. Lots of it. We created a content hub within the store addressing common questions. Articles explain ingredient benefits, dosage guidelines, and combination recommendations.

The blog connects directly to relevant products. Readers click through from educational content to purchase pages seamlessly. This content strategy drives organic search traffic while building authority in the supplement space.

Beyond articles, we built interactive tools that guide uncertain visitors:

quiz functionality matching health goals to appropriate products;

dietary restriction filters highlighting vegan and allergen-free options;

dosage calculators based on body weight and activity level;

combination checkers warning about potential interactions;

comparison tools showing ingredient differences between similar products.

Personalized results convert browsers into buyers effectively. When someone understands why a product fits their needs, the sale happens naturally.

Performance Metrics and Outcomes

VitaChipus measures success through several indicators. Subscription sign-ups increased 156 percent in the first quarter. Customer lifetime value grew as retention improved. Return rates dropped below industry averages.

The site now ranks for competitive supplement keywords organically. Paid advertising costs decreased as organic traffic grew. Content marketing investments continue generating returns months after publication. Mobile commerce accounts for 68 percent of orders — the responsive design handles small screens without sacrificing information density.

Brand Philosophy and Platform Needs

SHO believes quality matters more than quantity. They curate products that last, serve multiple purposes, and bring genuine joy. Their customer base shares these values and rejects typical consumerist messaging.

The previous website contradicted brand values visually. Cluttered layouts and aggressive sales tactics alienated the target audience. The shopping experience felt transactional rather than intentional. Customers wanted something different.

Design That Practices What It Preaches

We applied minimalist principles rigorously to the design process. Every element earns its place. Whitespace dominates rather than decoration. Typography carries information without ornamentation.

The homepage presents featured products without overwhelming choice. Curated selections rotate thoughtfully. Editorial introductions explain why specific items merit attention. The overall effect suggests careful consideration rather than abundant inventory.

Product pages strip away conventional ecommerce noise:

single hero images replace crowded galleries;

essential information appears immediately;

supplementary details expand on demand;

no countdown timers or artificial urgency;

no aggressive upselling or pop-ups.

This restraint builds trust with customers seeking escape from overwhelming retail experiences.

Curation and Discovery Approach

SHO succeeds through selection, not volume. We built discovery experiences that honor this approach. Collections organize around intentions rather than categories. Customers find products for specific needs and spaces.

The recommendation engine avoids typical algorithmic pushiness. Suggestions appear as gentle observations. Related items share design philosophy rather than just category. Cross-sells feel like helpful discoveries.

Search prioritizes relevance over recency. Results favor products that truly match queries. Sponsored placements and promotional manipulation have no place in the experience.

Sustainability Documentation

Intentional consumers research product impacts seriously. We created transparency frameworks matching their expectations. Material origins trace clearly. Manufacturing conditions document openly. End-of-life options appear honestly.

Each product shows environmental impact metrics where data exists. Carbon footprint, water usage, and packaging waste quantify consequences. This information helps customers align purchases with values.

The sustainability dashboard aggregates brand-level commitments. Progress toward goals displays publicly. Accountability measures keep promises meaningful rather than performative.

Technical Minimalism

The minimal aesthetic extended to technical implementation. Page weights stay remarkably light. Load times impress even on slow connections. The site feels fast because it genuinely is.

We achieved this through disciplined development:

Image optimization. Modern formats at appropriate sizes replace bloated assets.

Script minimization. Only essential functionality loads. Analytics and integrations stay lean.

Efficient caching. Repeat visitors experience near-instant loading.

Clean code. No framework bloat or unnecessary dependencies.

This technical discipline reflects brand values while improving business metrics.

Measured Success

SHO tracks metrics that matter to their model. Customer satisfaction scores improved significantly. Return rates dropped as expectations aligned with reality. Repeat purchase rates indicate genuine product appreciation.

Average order value decreased initially as aggressive bundling stopped. However, customer lifetime value increased as satisfaction drove loyalty. The trade-off proved worthwhile for sustainable business health.

We continue partnering with SHO on platform evolution. Recent additions include a product longevity tracking system and a repair service coordination feature. The store grows thoughtfully alongside the brand.

projects.solution:
What DrinkTMRW Needed From Their New Platform

The DrinkTMRW team approached Crocode with clear objectives. Their previous online presence lacked a seamless subscription flow, did not emphasize scientific credibility effectively, and offered limited flexibility for future campaigns or product launches. Key challenges included:

Establishing trust for science-based supplements through the website.

Driving first-time purchases and recurring subscriptions.

Supporting subscription-based supplement ecommerce and multi-user subscription options.

Ensuring mobile-first UX and conversion-focused Shopify design.

Building a platform that could scale with product line expansion and marketing campaigns.

The project required not just a Shopify theme but a fully custom headless development for a supplement brand, integrating subscription management, advanced analytics, and preorder functionality.

Technical Solutions Implemented

Headless Shopify Hydrogen Architecture

To meet performance and flexibility goals, we implemented a Shopify headless store development approach using Hydrogen:

Server-Side Rendering (SSR) with React for faster page loads and SEO-friendly content.

GraphQL and Storefront API integration to minimize requests and optimize data fetching.

Custom frontend development allowing flexible, conversion-driven layouts.

Deployment via Oxygen, Shopify’s hosting infrastructure, ensuring scalability and reliability.

This approach enabled DrinkTMRW to handle complex user flows, including subscriptions, preorders, and promotional campaigns, without the constraints of a standard Shopify theme.

UX/UI and Conversion Optimization (CRO)

We designed the platform around Shopify CRO best practices for nutraceutical ecommerce:

Product pages emphasized the value proposition, ingredient transparency, and trust factors like certifications and expert endorsements.

Simplified checkout and subscription flows reduced friction and cognitive load.

Mobile-first layout ensured accessibility and ease of use on smartphones and tablets.

Landing pages were structured to support marketing campaigns, optimizing for conversions and subscription sign-ups.

The result is a storefront where users quickly understand product benefits and can seamlessly subscribe or purchase.

Subscription Management and Retention

Integration with SKIO enabled advanced subscription ecommerce for supplements:

Recurring orders with flexible intervals.

Multi-user subscription management for households or shared plans.

Loyalty program integration and retention-focused workflows.

Customer portal for easy subscription management.

Subscriptions became a core driver of LTV optimization, turning first-time buyers into loyal recurring customers.

Reviews and Social Proof

We integrated Okendo to build social proof and trust:

Collect and display user reviews and ratings.

Support for user surveys to highlight product effectiveness.

Enhanced credibility on product pages to improve conversions.

By leveraging customer feedback, the site effectively communicates authenticity and quality.

Marketing Automation

Klaviyo integration enabled Shopify email marketing automation:

Welcome flows for new customers.

Abandoned cart recovery sequences.

Retention campaigns targeted at subscription users.

Segmentation for personalized, behavior-driven messaging.

This integration supports both customer acquisition and ongoing retention, crucial for subscription-based health supplement ecommerce.

Analytics and Data-Driven Optimization

We implemented comprehensive analytics to support Shopify data-driven CRO:

Event tracking via GA4, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Clarity, and GTAG.

Heatmaps and session recordings for behavioral insights.

Centralized dashboard for marketing and performance monitoring.

Data aggregation enabling precise ecommerce conversion analytics and informed decision-making.

This system allows DrinkTMRW to continuously optimize product pages, landing pages, and subscription funnels.

Preorder and Demand Management

To support new product launches, we developed a Shopify preorder system:

Preorder setup for upcoming supplement products.

Waitlist management to engage interested customers before launch.

Marketing tools for product drops, campaigns, and early access.

This infrastructure ensures that high-demand launches are smooth and predictable, maximizing revenue opportunities.

The Result: A Modern, Scalable Shopify Store for Nutraceuticals

The DrinkTMRW store now delivers a premium wellness supplement ecommerce experience:

Fast, headless Shopify Hydrogen development ensures performance and scalability.

Conversion-focused UX/UI design drives purchases and subscriptions.

Integrated SKIO subscriptions and Klaviyo flows maximize retention and LTV.

Transparent product storytelling and Okendo reviews build trust and authority.

Analytics and tracking support ongoing data-driven optimization.

By combining custom Shopify development with a subscription-ready, headless architecture, Crocode provided DrinkTMRW with a robust platform to grow their business, engage customers, and scale globally. This project demonstrates how Shopify headless development for a supplement brand can merge technical excellence, UX strategy, and ecommerce performance into a single, cohesive experience.
